posts.text: President Trump is calling for $350 billion MORE in Pentagon funding. That's on top of $1 *trillion* for the Pentagon advanced this year in Congress. For context: The total funding for the Pentagon in 2016 was $578.6 billion.

posts.text: Cynicism this week is easy. The same president celebrating our break from kings and lords is gathering obscene amounts of power — the kind that would give our founders a heart attack — growing his net worth by $2.2 billion in the first 18 months of his second term, all on the backs of extraordinary self-dealing and corruption. The left (including Mayor Mamdani) is backing soon-to-be members-of-Congress who oppose borders, police, interracial marriages, and believe America is a “fucking disgrace.
